howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能够管理消息通道（如 Telegram、Slack）与代理组之间的连接。你可以配置隔离级别、添加新的通道组，以及查看或调整通道设置。
howto.when: 当你添加了新通道、在设置过程中需要调整配置，或想单独重新配置现有通道时触发。

say.text: 帮我查看当前的通道配置
say.note: 显示所有通道和代理组的连接情况。
引导完成添加群组的步骤。

say.text: 将某个通道重新连接到另一个代理组
say.note: 询问你想更改的通道和目标组。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to wire messaging channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add new channel groups. You can view and adjust existing channel configurations.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during setup, or when reconfiguring existing channels standalone.

say_en.note: Displays all channels and agent group connections.
Walks through adding a group step by step.

say_en.text: Reassign a channel to a different agent group
say_en.note: Prompts for the channel and target group.
